description: Questions with known answer pages, for checking the hosted app's retrieval (python -m prototype.rerank_check). A case passes when a chunk from one of its `pages` (PDF pages) is among the reranker's top 5. Cases with a `key` were written from the text of a long chunk, most of them from its second half, where a reranker that reads fewer tokens of each passage would no longer see the answer; `key` is a phrase of the answer as it appears in the index, and the check takes the expected pages from the chunks that contain it. B, A and X cases are the verified questions in hosted/RESULTS-local.md; the table questions in eval/table_questions.json are checked too.
